VisionMission.title: Our Vision
VisionMission.description: To be a centre of excellence in Business Administration with quality education, research, and responsive to the needs of industry and society.

VisionMission.title: Our Mission
points: To achieve academic excellence through innovative teaching and learning practice.
To inculcate the spirit of innovation, creativity, research, and entrepreneurship.
To enhance employability through skill development and industry-institute interaction.
To develop professionals with ethical values and social responsibilities.

VisionMission.title: Our Vision
VisionMission.description: To be an institution of excellence in Commerce and Management education by equipping graduates with knowledge, skills, abilities and values to excel in their career and contribute to society.

VisionMission.title: Our Mission
points: To expose to core subjects of Commerce and Management through application based pedagogy.
To engage with industry partners and other stakeholders to ensure that the curriculum is relevant and updated.
To foster a culture of innovation and entrepreneurship and providing opportunities to develop their leadership skills.
To promote ethical and socially responsible practices and instilling values such as integrity, respect, and accountability in students.
To provide a supportive and inclusive learning environment that recognizes, celebrates diversity, and encourages continuous learning and personal growth.

VisionMission.title: Our Vision
VisionMission.description: To be recognized as a center of excellence in computer applications education, and innovation, engender graduates who are globally competitive and socially responsible professionals.

VisionMission.title: Our Mission
points: To prioritize the success of our students by providing them with the knowledge, skills, and experiences they need to excel in their careers.
To maintain high standards of academic rigor and quality in our curriculum, teaching, and research.
To ensure that our curriculum and teaching methodologies are up-to-date and aligned with industry needs and standards.
To promote ethical and responsible use of technology and foster a culture of diversity, inclusion, and sustainability.

VisionMission.title: Our Vision
VisionMission.description: To create a community of highly skilled and innovative professionals, who can contribute to scientific research, technological advancement, and societal well-being.

VisionMission.title: Our Mission
points: To provide a comprehensive education that emphasizes critical thinking, problem-solving.
To equip students with a strong foundation in theoretical and practical aspects of physics, mathematics, and computer science through laboratory experiments, research projects.
To develop the necessary skills and competencies required for scientific research, innovation.

VisionMission.title: Our Vision
VisionMission.description: To foster technical professionalism in the field of computer application through industry compatibility, technology assistance, and advanced research.

VisionMission.title: Our Mission
points: To provide a comprehensive and quality education that emphasizes both theoretical and practical aspects of computer applications.
To focus on developing technical, professional, and entrepreneurial skills among students.
To create a conducive learning environment that fosters creativity, critical thinking, problem-solving, teamwork, and communication skills.
To provide opportunities for research and development, industry interaction, and exposure to emerging technologies to prepare students for future challenges.
To empower students with the necessary skills, knowledge, and expertise to pursue a successful career in the field of computer applications and related areas.

VisionMission.title: Our Vision
VisionMission.description: To be a leading Program in commerce education recognized for its commitment to academic excellence, research culture, entrepreneurship and industry ready.

VisionMission.title: Our Mission
points: To accentuate quality education with a strong foundation of commerce, and enhance analytical skills to excel in the field of commerce.
To nurture accounting skills, managerial skills, and leadership qualities to meet the challenges of the business world.
To establish an industry-academia interface for understanding opportunities by the students in related areas of finance, commerce, and banking.
To inculcate a research culture mindset and contribute to the stream and society at large.

VisionMission.title: Our Vision
VisionMission.description: हिन्दी भाषा और हिन्दी साहित्य के माध्यम से छात्रों में शिक्षा का महत्व और भारतीय सांस्कृतिक मूल्यों का विकास ।

VisionMission.title: Our Mission
points: भारत की जनसम्पर्क भाषा हिन्दी के अध्ययन से नवीन प्रथाओं का समग्र शिक्षण और मानक शिक्षा को प्रोत्साहित करना और साहित्यिक सृजनात्मक शिक्षा को प्रभावित करना।
छात्रों में देश प्रेम और स्वदेश भक्ति निर्माण कर सामाजिक रूप से जिम्मेदार नागरिक बनने में विश्वास पैदा करना।
आधुनिक शिक्षा का उद्देश्य ज्ञान का विस्तार करना, व्यवसायिक शिक्षा को प्रोत्साहन देना।
हिन्दी भाषा शिक्षण से उपजीविका का अवसर प्राप्त होता है – हिन्दी अनुवादक, बैंक, रेल, डाक घर, मीडिया और केन्द्र सरकार के कार्यालयों में नौकरियाँ उपलब्ध हैं।

VisionMission.title: Our Vision
VisionMission.description: To promote English learning environment that enables the students to perceive effective and professional communication skills in English.

VisionMission.title: Our Mission
points: To inculcate Listening, Speaking, Reading and Writing (LSRW) skills in English.
To promote English language learning skills through activity-based education for better career opportunities in the competitive world.
To facilitate competence among the students to acquire knowledge of effective speaking and academic writing skills in English through technology-based innovative teaching methodology.
To nurture personal and professional development of students through confidence-building activities.

VisionMission.title: ದೂರ ದೃಷ್ಠಿ
VisionMission.description: ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಕನ್ನಡ ಭಾಷೆ ಮತ್ತು ಸಾಹಿತ್ಯದ ಅಧ್ಯಯನದ ಮೂಲಕ ಭಾಷಾ ಜ್ಞಾನ, ನೆಲ-ಜಲ ಸಂರಕ್ಷಣೆ, ಸಾಂಸ್ಕೃತಿಕ ಅರಿವು ಹಾಗೂ ಮಾನವೀಯ ಮೌಲ್ಯಗಳನ್ನು ಬೆಳೆಸಿ ಜವಾಬ್ದಾರಿಯುತ ಪ್ರಜೆಗಳನ್ನಾಗಿ ರೂಪಿಸುವುದು.

VisionMission.title: ಗುರಿಗಳು
points: ಕನ್ನಡ ಸಂಸ್ಕೃತಿ ಮತ್ತು ಪರಂಪರೆಯ ಮೌಲ್ಯಗಳನ್ನು ಪರಿಚಯಿಸುವುದರ ಮೂಲಕ ಕನ್ನಡ ಭಾಷಾ ಅಧ್ಯಯನವನ್ನು ಪ್ರೋತ್ಸಾಯಿಸುವುದು.
ಸಾಹಿತ್ಯದ ಅಧ್ಯಯನ ಹಾಗೂ ಸಂಶೋಧನಾತ್ಮಕ ಚಿಂತನೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾಹಿತಿ ತಂತ್ರಜ್ಞಾನದ ಅಗತ್ಯತೆಯನ್ನು ಪರಿಚಯಿಸಿ, ಬಳಕೆಗೆ ಅವಕಾಶವನ್ನು ಕಲ್ಪಿಸುವುದು.
ಸಮಕಾಲೀನ ಸ್ಪರ್ಧೆಗಳಿಗೆ ಸೂಕ್ತ ಮಾದರಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಸಾಹಿತ್ಯಾಧ್ಯಯನವನ್ನು ರೂಪಿಸುವುದು.
ಸಾಹಿತ್ಯಾಧ್ಯಯನದ ಅಡಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ವಿವಿಧ ಸ್ಪರ್ಧೆಗಳನ್ನು ಏರ್ಪಡಿಸುವುದು.
ಶೈಕ್ಷಣಿಕ ವರ್ಷದಲ್ಲಿ ಸಾಹಿತ್ಯಾಸಕ್ತಿಯನ್ನು ಹೆಚ್ಚಿಸಲು ಐತಿಹಾಸಿಕ ಸ್ಥಳಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಪ್ರಕೃತಿಯ ಒಡನಾಟ ಬೆಳೆಯಲು ಶೈಕ್ಷಣಿಕ ಪ್ರವಾಸ ಕೈಗೊಳ್ಳುವುದು.
